title: Scope ROM-data validation to the selected deliverable and its risks
changes: Require a selection checkpoint with a defined deliverable, required evidence, risks and stopping condition. Prioritize removing original-ROM dependencies, connecting extracted resources to runtime consumption and unblocking representative gameplay.

Reuse accepted proof while its inputs, implementation and assumptions remain valid. Run affected regressions when evidence is invalidated and retain stronger checks for correctness-critical behavior and existing acceptance gates.

Stop after scoped acceptance or record an essential missing proof and its prerequisite. Keep optional leads in the backlog and preserve original task IDs, historical evidence, paused work and shared-resource ownership.
validation: Checked all 15 changed local links and verified byte-for-byte preservation of the operational queue and existing validation and recovery evidence. The ROM-data checklist, handoff structure and legacy archive checks passed.
limitations: Workflow guidance and project memory only. Runtime validation and operational task states were outside this unit.
